title: borreria latifolia f. minor
intro: Borreria latifolia f. minor, commonly known as Borreria, is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Borreria are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of Borreria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and health benefits, including its potential to protect against oxidative stress and promote wound healing.
